# My Thai Taxes

> Free Thai personal income tax calculator and reference for expats, freelancers, and residents living and working in Thailand.

My Thai Taxes helps individuals estimate their Thai personal income tax (PIT), understand allowances and deductions, and check monthly withholding — covering salaried employees, freelancers, sole proprietors, and company directors.

## Tools

- [Annual Tax Calculator](https://www.mythaitaxes.com/annual-tax/): Step-by-step calculator covering income, deductions, allowances, withholding, and a full tax breakdown.
- [Monthly Withholding Estimator](https://www.mythaitaxes.com/monthly-withholding/): Quick tool to check whether the correct amount of tax is being withheld from a monthly salary.

## API for AI agents and developers

- [MCP tool endpoint](https://mythaitaxes-mcp.hannwill999.workers.dev/mcp): Stateless MCP (Streamable HTTP, JSON-only) endpoint exposing `calculate_thai_annual_income_tax` — computes Thai PIT for a salaried employee from income, marital status, dependents, and deductions. Free, no API key required.
- [REST endpoint](https://mythaitaxes-mcp.hannwill999.workers.dev/api/calculate-annual-tax): The same calculation as a plain `POST` JSON endpoint, for non-MCP clients.

## Reference

- [Articles](https://www.mythaitaxes.com/articles/): Guides on Thai tax residency, foreign income remittance, double tax agreements, and more.
- [FAQ](https://www.mythaitaxes.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about Thai tax filing and compliance.
- [About](https://www.mythaitaxes.com/about/): What the site is and who maintains it.

## Notes

- Figures are estimates for informational purposes only and not a substitute for professional tax advice.
- Tax constants and brackets are current for the 2026 tax year; verify against https://www.rd.go.th/english/ before filing.
